title: Machine Learning Workflow: Importing, Modeling, and Evaluating Your ML Model

cues.en: Today, we are talking about the machine learning process.
cues.zh: 今天要談的是機器學習的流程。

cues.en: As you will see from the practical tutorials of this course, there is a specific step-by-step process that we typically always follow when building machine learning models.
cues.zh: 你會在課程實作中看到，建立機器學習模型時，通常會遵循一套明確的步驟。

cues.en: So, let's have a look at what this process entails.
cues.zh: 來看看這個流程包含哪些內容。

cues.en: This process has three main steps.
cues.zh: 這個流程主要有三個步驟。

cues.en: The first one is called data pre-processing, and here we import the data, we clean the data, and we split the data into training and test sets.
cues.zh: 第一步叫做資料前處理，包括匯入、清理資料，以及將資料切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: A quick note is that in this course, we won't be focusing a lot on cleaning the data.
cues.zh: 先提醒一下，這門課不會花太多時間在資料清理上。

cues.en: That's because our data is pre-cleaned, so that we can really hone in our other skills related to machine learning.
cues.zh: 因為資料已經事先清理過，好讓我們專注訓練其他機器學習技能。

cues.en: But bear in mind that in real-world situations, clean the data is quite an important step.
cues.zh: 不過請記住，在真實情境中，清理資料是非常重要的步驟。

cues.en: Next, we move onto modeling, where we first build the model, then we train the model, and we make the prediction.
cues.zh: 接下來是建模，先建立模型，再訓練模型，最後進行預測。

cues.en: So, this is the fun part of machine learning, and in this course you'll get a great exposure to several different models and you'll be able to practice your skills there.
cues.zh: 這是機器學習有趣的部分，課程中會接觸多種不同模型，讓你實際練習。

cues.en: And finally, we move on to evaluations.
We will calculate some performance metrics and make a verdict about our model, whether it's a good-fitting model and if it works for our data or not.
cues.zh: 我們會計算一些效能指標，判斷模型擬合得好不好，以及是否適合這份資料。

cues.en: And this is a very important step to make sure that the models we build really serve the purpose that they're designed for.
cues.zh: 這一步非常重要，才能確保建立的模型真的能達成原本設計的目的。

cues.en: So, there we go. That's the machine learning process.
cues.zh: 這就是機器學習的流程。

cues.en: And in this course, you'll definitely have lots of opportunities to get some great hands-on experience with it.
cues.zh: 在這門課中，你一定會有很多機會，透過實作熟悉它。

cues.en: And I look forward to seeing you next time.

cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
